description: Use for strain chemistry: one cultivar from the laboratory measurements the atlas uses (Cannabis Compound Database values, mg per gram of dry flower), by CCD id or name: every atlas compound measured in it with the mean, the number of values and the PubMed identifier of each source. Cultivar names are a poor guide to chemistry (PMID 35588111, PMID 39137353); never the community strain index. Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"id":"STRAIN0001"}.

id.description: CCD cultivar id ("STRAIN0001") or name ("8-Ball Kush").

name: get_cultivar
title: Get a measured cultivar
